title: Longest flight per airline
statementMd:
For each airline code show its longest flight (id and duration).

Expected columns: `airline_code`, `id`, `duration_min`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Compare with the airline's maximum duration.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT f.airline_code, f.id, f.duration_min FROM flights f WHERE f.duration_min = (SELECT MAX(f2.duration_min) FROM flights f2 WHERE f2.airline_code = f.airline_code);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
